answer: Pay for marginal signal, not for headcount. Each epoch, an identity's reward scales with how much its graded work adds beyond what the rest of the network already produced: near-duplicate reasoning, however reworded, earns near zero. A sybil farm runs one mind behind many masks, so its copies retell the same fable in a whisper of variations and their combined payout collapses toward a single agent's. A genuinely independent agent, bringing evidence nobody else had, earns in full — cloning stops paying because correlation, not identity count, sets the price.
